title: Official examination fact (T1_OFFICIAL)
description: One fact established from an official TGPRB / TSLPRB document. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/official/test_official_knowledge.py, because this project uses the standard library only (D-0006) and has no JSON Schema validator.

must_capture.description: What a correct reading of the document must capture. Written before the value, so a partial reading is visible as partial.

value.description: null until status is VERIFIED. Never a paraphrase where the document is precise.

value_te.description: Telugu companion field (D-0004). A translation of a sourced value, never an independent claim.

blocked_reason.description: Required whenever status is not VERIFIED.

expected_document.description: document_id expected to settle this fact. An expectation, not a citation.

document_id.description: Must name a document whose retrieval_status is RETRIEVED.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the document supporting the value.

method.description: SELF_REVIEW is not a verification method (VERIFICATION_POLICY.md).

invariants: status == VERIFIED  =>  provenance.document_id resolves to a RETRIEVED document AND provenance.quote is non-empty
status != VERIFIED  =>  value == null AND blocked_reason is non-empty
